name: Sports and other prediction, with Obsmetrologia, beyond Kalshi
asks:
Your job in this session is to work to extend our ability to operate on the Kalshi and other prediction markets. ANother agent, Codex, is working in two sessions, one on Kalshi stuff itself and the other on weather prediction. Your job is to work more on sports prediction stuff, specifically enriching our science and engineering as much as we can, using-and-improving our best scientific research on games, concurrent game systems, economics, etc., to find the best strategy spaces, navigatge their potentials, and determine what's accurate. This should rely heavily on our strange obsmetrologia math ideas. I feel like the double banana stuff is specifically useful. Merlin and Arthur running around a pebble forest, throwing bananas at each other; and what it was, was football.

also, you should do more to check more to integrate in more math, specify more, make things close to shared typed strategies, rules, arena, players, i.e. that all our ecosystem uses, or should be using. content addressing, all these tools are here to help you kick ass at the assigned task, while continuing to assume

1) other people are tasking their agents with "make money on kalshi"
2) others people are not likely to task their agents to be so aware of concurrent game system theory and
3) we're pretty sure no one else has math like obsmetrologia which is all about measuring coordination and conflict in complex systems
4) assume that we know the real world means things like fees and stuff mean there's no way to just, win by doing what everyone else does, harder or faster, and thus
5) we should keep one eye on imagining what no one else would think to do to gain better our universal brier down as close to zero as we can, and using that imagination to try new weird shit, like the double banana was an example, i think coloring wang tiles is another, and there's many many.

Great, continue. If you get stuck on sports stuff due to lack of data, move onto another form of prediction that we seem well-primed to take on next.

x-provenance.recorded-by: program-manager (bare-cedar-fog-claude, dispatched under the Leader standing direction of 2026-10-09)
x-provenance.basis: Opening prompt of the Leader on Bare Cedar Fog, carried as a requirement record by the board-requirement-intake skill. The raised-by field and asks are the Leader's own words; the requirements below are the program manager's EARS rendering of what those words ask, and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group holds, for sports and then other prediction domains, strategy spaces measured with Obsmetrologia whose forecasts are scored against market prices net of fees.

requirements.says: The strategy-space record shall model each studied sport as a concurrent game of players, rules, arena and strategies in the Group's shared typed vocabulary for those four.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "shared typed strategies, rules, arena, players, i.e. that all our ecosystem uses".

requirements.says: The strategy-space record shall measure coordination and conflict among players with Obsmetrologia and name the Obsmetrologia result each measurement uses.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "This should rely heavily on our strange obsmetrologia math ideas."

requirements.says: The strategy-space record shall state the forecast's out-of-sample Brier score and its fee-adjusted edge against the market price on the same events.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "determine what's accurate", "universal brier down as close to zero as we can", and fees mean "no way to just, win by doing what everyone else does".

requirements.says: The strategy-space record shall evaluate the double-banana formalization of football and a Wang-tile-colouring formalization as candidate strategy spaces.
requirements.rationale: The Leader gave both as examples of "new weird shit".

requirements.says: If a sport lacks the data to fit its model, then the strategy-space record shall name the missing data and a prediction domain the Group's tools can fit instead.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "If you get stuck on sports stuff due to lack of data, move onto another form of prediction".

requirements.says: The strategy-space record shall list the venues beyond Kalshi where its forecasts could be priced, with each venue's published eligibility terms for United States persons.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "Kalshi and other prediction markets"; the session found several venues bar US persons.

conditions.says: A sports strategy-space record exists in the game-ludics section.
The record names the Obsmetrologia results it uses.
The record carries a Brier score and a fee-adjusted edge.
The record lists venues with US-person terms.

board-opening.context: Codex held the Kalshi and weather sessions at the time; this session's lane was sports science and engineering. The engineering consequences (one Kalshi system, shared typed vocabulary, cloud compute) are carried by the Kalshi system record. The wording "EVM wallet for research and games" in the dispatch is carried by its own record because no sentence of the opening transcript states it.
